metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app: app
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: nginx:1.31.5
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
              name: http
EOF
